description: This file defines the 'Online' controller class for the OpenCart admin dashboard extension, providing functionalities for rendering the online users dashboard, saving settings, and displaying online user statistics.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Controller class for managing the online users dashboard in the OpenCart admin panel, with methods for rendering the dashboard, saving configuration, and providing online user statistics.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the online users dashboard page with breadcrumbs, configuration options, and includes common page components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving dashboard settings, checking permissions, and returning JSON response with success or error message.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Provides online user count statistics formatted with suffixes (K, M, B, T) and renders the online info view.
